'''Alitta's Focus''' is an [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Alitta Guilebloom]], a [[boss]] in [[Arbor Bay]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Illusion Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Jeweled Chakram]] from collector [[Kilgor Rageheart]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription
OR
*[[Jeweled Chakram]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription
AND
*White [[dye]]
